Select the VAR lag order

Source: R/varm.R
var_select.Rd

Computes AIC, HQ (Hannan-Quinn), SC (Schwarz/BIC) and FPE for lags 1..pmax on a common estimation sample (the first pmax observations are dropped for every p).

Usage

var_select(Y, pmax = 8L, const = TRUE, trend = FALSE, exog = NULL, vars = NULL)

Arguments

Y

data frame (preferred), ts or numeric matrix (T x K) of endogenous variables. Non-numeric columns of a data frame are dropped; a Date column is kept as $dates and used by the plots.

pmax

maximum lag.

const

include a constant.

trend

include a linear trend.

exog

optional T x q matrix or data frame of exogenous regressors (contemporaneous, treated like deterministic terms; future values are then required for forecasting).

vars

<tidy-select> columns of Y that are the endogenous variables, e.g. vars = c(infl, rate). Default: all numeric columns.

Value

list with selection (the optimal lag per criterion) and the criteria matrix.

See also

Other estimation: lag_matrices(), stability(), varm()

Examples

var_select(yraw, pmax = 4)$selection
#> AIC  HQ  SC FPE 
#>   3   2   2   3
